original.target_description: Verified original primary report. Five scenarios and five tests per scenario located. Input study 2, general attitudes description, and page locator do not uniquely identify a scenario and contrast without mapping by table order.

p.quote: The “Scenario” column lists vignettes and sample sizes for studies 1–5. ... The last two columns report five hypothesis tests for each study, each assessing a different criterion for the A/B Effect (ABE).

notes: Identity verified from canonical text: matching title Objecting to experiments even while approving of the policies or treatments they compare; authors Patrick R. Heck, Christopher F. Chabris, Duncan J. Watts, Michelle N. Meyer; DOI 10.1073/pnas.2009030117; PNAS 117(32), 18948–18950 (2020). Europe PMC fullTextXML parse contains abstract, main report, Table 1, methods, references, and data availability, consistent with a published primary report rather than abstract-only excerpts. No PDF supplied. Only pval_value_o assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Table 1 identifies studies 1–5 collectively but does not explicitly label an individual scenario study 2. No scenario is assigned by row order. The general description also does not identify a contrast. Candidate paired tests below are Mean(A,B) vs. Mean(AB), then Min(A,B) vs. Mean(AB), respectively. Hospital Safety Checklist: t = 7.53***, d = 0.58 ± 0.16; t = 3.23**, d = 0.24 ± 0.15. Best Drug: Walk-In Clinic: t = 4.77***, d = 0.39 ± 0.17; t = 3.85***, d = 0.31 ± 0.16. Consumer Genetic Testing: t = 12.99***, d = 0.76 ± 0.13; t = 6.58***, d = 0.39 ± 0.12. Employee Retirement Plans: t = 10.29***, d = 0.64 ± 0.13; t = 5.46***, d = 0.34 ± 0.12. Autonomous Vehicles: t = 2.52*, d = 0.15 ± 0.12; t = –4.28, d = –0.25 ± 0.11. Symbols denote statistical significance for ABE: *** P < 0.001; ** P = 0.001, * P = 0.01. Each scenario additionally reports three percentage tests marked ***. Candidate results are not selected as the target. No metrics converted or N derived.
